paragraphs.text: Aisha of Sparks and Smoke is a legendary Ghitu human warrior from Dominaria .

Aisha appears as a dark-skinned female human warrior who can attack with fire. She has blue line tattoos on her face and her hair is half white and half red. She wields a wavy-shaped sword and despite being a warrior she appears to be able to also attack and/or manipulate fire using her hands. This causes her to be surrounded by smoke likely leading to her epitaph “of Sparks and Smoke”.
